# A record conditioned on a label

## Statement
This record would apply wherever the material was labelled a teardown. That is
exactly what I-10 forbids: the label is written after the decision, so a decision
conditioned on it would depend on its own output.

## Applies when
material_label is Teardown

## Influences
- S-08 · `E-13.reader_path` — the ordered moves.

## Conflicts
None known.

## Source
A fixture for §8 rule 4.
